title: Fix Desktop White Screen in Container
description: Electron crashes with FATAL zygote namespace error when running in devcontainer. Need to disable Chromium sandbox for container environments.
summary: Fixed three issues preventing the desktop app from running in devcontainer: (1) Electron sandbox/zygote crash — added --no-sandbox flag to electron-forge start in package.json. (2) GPU process crash killing the app — added app.disableHardwareAcceleration() for container environments in main.ts. (3) White screen from module loading stall — changed Sketchpad import to React.lazy() dynamic import in renderer.tsx, and fixed ESM export ordering in Sketchpad.tsx by using re-export syntax for Canvas/HorizontalWindows/VerticalWindows. Cleaned up all debug code after verifying the app launches without errors.
